One process per revision in each of 12 balanced blocks. Absolute microseconds per batch of 16.
The original cold+hot pair ran before the 64 probe batches. first=first probe batch; repeated=per-process median of all 64 probe batches.
Fixed checkpoint order. Keys count and time between successive checkpoints. Per-stage medians need not sum to total.
Intervals in profile-deltas.txt resample independent process blocks, never inner repetitions.
